results.title: Application loads and shows the first-use screen
results.preconditions: App started with `python app.py`; browser opens http://localhost:8501
results.expected: Page loads with the UOS header, sidebar navigation, welcome screen with example questions and a message composer with a Send button.
results.actual: Page loaded=True, title='UOS Faculty Onboarding Chatbot', composer=True, send button=True, sidebar=True.

results.title: Contact lookup returns the HR phone number with a source
steps: Type the question in the composer
results.test_data: What is the phone number of the Human Resources Department?
results.expected: The bot answers with the Human Resources phone number exactly as printed in the handbook and shows a Sources row.
results.actual: Answered=True in 2.7s. Answer: "Human Resources (contact directory): telephone +971 6 5050023.". Sources: Verified · Institutional Navigation, UOS Faculty Handbook 2025/26, Page 54 · Contact Information

results.title: Supporting evidence panel can be expanded
results.expected: The evidence list expands and shows the handbook passages and page numbers used for the answer.
results.actual: Evidence panel found and opened=True.

results.title: Handbook policy question is answered with citations
results.test_data: How many office hours must full-time faculty hold, and what is the teaching load per semester?
results.expected: A grounded answer stating office-hour and teaching-load rules from the Faculty Handbook, with page citations.
results.actual: Answered=True in 2.7s. Answer: "Full-Time Faculty: Full-time faculty members in academic and career/technical programs are required to schedule a minimum of five office hours per week, spread over a minimum of two days. These office hours provide dedicated time for students to discuss course". Sources: Verified · Teaching & Learning, UOS Faculty Handbook 2025/26, Page 79 · Responsibility to Office Hours

results.title: Blackboard how-to question is answered from the attendance guide
results.test_data: How do I take attendance in Blackboard?
results.expected: Step-by-step answer taken from the Blackboard Attendance guide, citing that guide.
results.actual: Answered=True in 4.3s. Answer: "To take attendance in Blackboard Ultra, go to the Course Content page, select Mark attendance in the Details & Actions panel, then click Add Attendance; set your grade schema (present, late, absent) and grade display option (points, percentage, letters), and s". Sources: Attendance Tool in Blackboard Ultra, Page 1 · Access Attendance:

results.title: Out-of-scope question is politely refused (no hallucination)
results.test_data: What is the weather in Sharjah today?
results.expected: The bot states the question is outside the approved university documents and does not invent an answer.
results.actual: Answered=True. Response: "No supporting evidence found  I do not have this information.  The approved documents do not state this, or the question needs rewording. Try naming the policy, procedure, office or date you mean."

results.title: Vague request gets a clarification / guidance response
results.expected: The bot asks the user to be more specific or explains what topics it can help with, without making up policy.
results.actual: Answered=True. Response: "No supporting evidence found  I do not have this information.  The approved documents do not state this, or the question needs rewording. Try naming the policy, procedure, office or date you mean."

results.title: Empty message is not sent
steps: Click into the empty message box
results.expected: Nothing is sent; no user bubble or answer appears.
results.actual: User messages before=0, after=0.

results.title: Shift+Enter inserts a new line instead of sending
results.expected: The message box contains two lines and nothing is sent.
results.actual: Textarea value='line one\nline two', sent=False.

results.title: Arabic question is answered in Arabic with a right-to-left layout
results.test_data: ما هو رقم هاتف قسم الموارد البشرية؟ (What is the HR phone number?)
results.expected: The page is right-to-left and the bot answers in Arabic with the HR phone number preserved exactly.
results.actual: Direction=rtl, answered=True. Answer: "الموارد البشرية (دليل الاتصال): هاتف +971 6 5050023."

results.title: Language button switches the interface back to English and keeps the conversation
steps: Click the language button (English) in the header
results.expected: The interface switches to English, left-to-right, and the Arabic conversation is still shown.
results.actual: Button clicked=True, lang=en, direction=ltr, messages kept=2.

results.title: Previous conversations are saved and listed on the History page
results.preconditions: TC-02 to TC-10 conversations were created
steps: Open Conversation history from the sidebar
results.expected: The History page lists the earlier conversations with titles taken from their first question.
results.actual: Earlier conversation titles found on page=True.

results.title: A saved conversation reopens after page reload without re-asking
steps: Click the 'What is the phone number…' conversation in the sidebar
results.expected: The stored question and answer are shown again from the database.
results.actual: Messages displayed after reopening=2.

results.title: Onboarding checklist lists the onboarding tasks with overall progress
results.expected: A dashboard of onboarding tasks (Teaching, Faculty services, Institutional) with a progress ring.
results.actual: Task cards=12, progress=0%.

results.title: Marking a task completed updates the progress
steps: Click 'Mark completed' on the 'HR pre-joining documents' task
results.expected: The task status becomes Completed, a 'Saved' note appears and the completed counter / percentage increases.
results.actual: Clicked=True, progress 0% -> 8%, completed count=1.

results.title: Guided procedure moves step by step with Next
results.expected: The navigator starts at Step 1 and shows Step 3 after two clicks, with the exact guide text for each step.
results.actual: Counter before='STEP 1 OF 8', after='STEP 3 OF 8'.

results.title: Resource finder search returns the matching document
results.expected: The iThenticate guidelines document is listed first.
results.actual: Results=2, first result='Document'.

results.title: Theme button switches between light and dark mode
steps: Click the dark/light mode button in the header
results.expected: The whole interface switches to the dark theme.
results.actual: Theme before=light, after=dark.

results.title: Settings page shows language, theme and accessibility options
results.expected: Settings for interface/answer language, theme, larger text and reduced motion are shown.
results.actual: Options found: Language, Theme, Text size, motion, Voice.

results.title: Guest profile page shows what this browser has saved
results.expected: The page shows the guest identity, saved conversation count / onboarding progress and an optional display name.
results.actual: Page text starts: "Skip to the content | UNIVERSITY OF SHARJAH | Faculty Onboarding Assistant | New chat | WORKSPACE | Assistant chat | Onboarding checklist | Guided procedures | Resources & documents | Conversation history | YOUR GUEST SE"

results.title: Phone-width layout has no horizontal overflow and a slide-in menu
steps: Open the chat at phone width
results.expected: The page fits the screen without sideways scrolling and the navigation opens as a slide-in drawer.
results.actual: Horizontal overflow=False; menu opened.
